title: The first warriors are already walking the lands of Ashram Online: real players exploring, battling, and forging their destiny in a world reborn after The Breaking, the open beta is alive and we're waiting for you!
author: Fun_Bumblebee_3978
selftext:
https://preview.redd.it/t0q031cxkbrh1.png?width=1919&format=png&auto=webp&s=e528231848ed0deb4947cdd04d92678da39c7ab4

Ashram Online is a fantasy MMORPG set in a world scarred by The Breaking, a cataclysm that shattered the balance between the three forces that held it together: Vyāna, Dhāra, and Antā. From that fracture rose the Dissonants, and now it's up to the players to stand against them.

Choose from four classes: the raw strength of the Vajrahn, the deadly precision of the Sahira, the discipline of the Yodha, or the arcane power of the Elunar. Level up, gather materials, craft your gear, team up with other players, and uncover the secrets of a world that is only beginning to reveal itself.

Now available in open beta on Steam. Jump in, create your character, and be among the first to write the history of Ashram.  
  
**llBooM**, developer of Ashram Online
